visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with black hair in twin braids, wearing a yellow and orange plaid oversized shirt over a white ribbed top and beige shorts, walks down a sidewalk in a sunny urban area. She speaks directly to the camera while gesturing enthusiastically. (2) She demonstrates a fashion hack by taking the bottom corner of her oversized shirt and buttoning it toward the back. The camera follows her movements as she adjusts the fabric to create a draped, fitted silhouette. (3) She turns around to show the back of the shirt, which now has a unique cinched appearance. She continues walking, her arms moving rhythmically as she explains the style. (4) The woman spreads her arms wide and sways her body side-to-side, showing how the shirt stays in place. The background includes street parking and multi-story residential buildings. (5) She stands next to a man wearing a black t-shirt and a wide-brimmed black hat. She holds a small microphone near him as they talk. (6) She laughs, shakes hands with the man, and waves goodbye to the camera. (7) Both the woman and the man are riding a white scooter; the man drives while the woman sits behind him. Both are wearing helmets. She points to her legs to show how the shirt covers them, smiling at the camera.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-energy female voice speaking rapidly in Traditional Chinese, accompanied by a bright, mid-tempo electronic-pop BGM. The voice is clear with high pitch modulation. (2) As she manipulates the shirt, the sound of fabric rustling is briefly audible. A light 'pop' SFX accompanies the appearance of comic-style text overlays. (3) During the interview segment, the acoustic environment shifts to a more open outdoor setting with low-frequency street rumble and occasional high-frequency bird or wind chirps. A male voice responds with a calm, lower-pitched tone. (4) In the final segment on the scooter, a noticeable 'whoosh' of wind noise and a steady mechanical engine hum enter the mix. The female voice increases in loudness to maintain clarity over the engine noise while the BGM remains constant until the end.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Instruction -> Validation -> Practical Application
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To share a practical and stylish fashion hack for wearing oversized shirts (the 'boyfriend shirt' look) while showing a playful interaction with a partner and demonstrating a secondary benefit (sun protection).
